source.timingScope: From task start to the final decision; prototype timings include region marking, OCR waiting and saving the decision.
source.methodClarificationOrigin: Additional account supplied by the author; not an independent reconstruction from the original recordings.

design.primaryAnalysis: P2-P5; P1 is the developer walkthrough and is summarised separately.

preview.display: Original and candidate shown side by side.
preview.zoom: Native browser zoom using the mouse wheel, according to the author.

sharedTaskInstructions.scope: The same instruction wording was supplied for both conditions.
sharedTaskInstructions.englishTranslation: Check whether the product image after a background change is acceptable. Only the background may change; the net weight, mark and packaging details must be preserved. Choose accept, return for revision or unresolved, and explain the reason.
sharedTaskInstructions.languageNote: English translation of the instruction wording supplied in Chinese by the author.

familiarisation.prototype: A brief demonstration of region selection, enlarged crops, OCR output and decision submission, followed by one unrelated practice image before formal tasks.
familiarisation.preview: No separate demonstration; the author described participants as familiar with ordinary image viewing.
familiarisation.limitation: Familiarisation was not identical across conditions.

P1.effort: Prototype required more effort: region marking, reading OCR and writing reasons. Preview was faster.
P1.detection: Crops and OCR directed attention to weight; full images could distract from detail.
P1.ocr: Useful evidence, with some hesitation when noisy readings required visual checking.

P2.effort: Prototype required more effort and more steps, including writing reasons.
P2.detection: Preview missed a small digit change and produced a colour-based concern. The crop directed attention to the label.
P2.ocr: Warnings helped direct attention to digits; glare-related failures caused confusion.

P3.effort: Prototype involved more effort through drawing, checking output and writing reasons.
P3.detection: Detected B in both conditions; the prototype directed attention to marked details.

P4.effort: Prototype took longer and required more effort.
P4.detection: Missed B in preview; the OCR warning helped reveal the changed amount.
P4.ocr: Warnings were helpful; unresolved allowed uncertainty when recognition failed.

P5.effort: More prototype steps required more effort than viewing two full images.
P5.detection: Detected problems in both conditions; crops made detail comparison easier.
P5.ocr: Helpful in most scenes; also inspected images rather than relying entirely on OCR.
